name: Path of the Badger
text: When triggered, you Move up to 3, then you may deal 2 damage to an enemy within range.

name: Path of the Elephant
text: When triggered, you gain 2 Iron Tokens.

name: Path of the Gecko
text: When triggered, choose one: you Heal -or- you remove up to 3 Status Tokens you hold.

name: Path of the Monkey
text: When triggered, you add a 1 to your Action Pool.

name: Path of the Rabbit
text: When triggered, you gain 4 Speed Tokens.

name: Path of the Tiger
text: When triggered, you gain 2 Power Tokens.

name: Path of the Turtle
text: When triggered, you gain temporary Armor.
